## Pull request overview

Unifies ObjectUI’s navigation configuration around a canonical `NavigationItem` model (aligned with `@objectstack/spec`), introduces `NavigationArea` for domain/area partitioning, and updates Console sidebar UI + validation/tests to support the new structure.

**Changes:**
- Add `NavigationItem` / `NavigationArea` to `@object-ui/types` and extend `AppSchema` with `navigation` + `areas` (deprecate legacy `menu`).
- Add Zod validators for the unified navigation model and export them via the Zod entrypoint.
- Update Console `AppSidebar` to resolve navigation from an active area and add spec + unit tests + roadmap entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

| packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts | Adds `NavigationItemSchema` / `NavigationAreaSchema` and extends `AppSchema` validation. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Exports new navigation types and `menuItemToNavigationItem()` from `@object-ui/types`. |
| packages/types/src/app.ts | Defines `NavigationItem` / `NavigationArea`, deprecates legacy `MenuItem`, adds migration transform. |
| packages/types/src/__tests__/navigation-model.test.ts | Adds unit tests for new types, Zod schemas, and migration transform. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Adds area switcher UI + resolves navigation from active area; uses it for mobile nav. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/SpecCompliance.test.tsx | Expands spec compliance assertions for new nav item types and areas. |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Adds Phase 19 and updates “Last Updated” metadata. |
</details>



<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx:490**
* Mobile bottom bar currently filters out only `group` items, but `resolvedNavigation` can now include `separator`/`action` (and already could include `url`/`report`), which this code doesn't handle when building `href` (leading to `'#'` links and empty/meaningless items). Filter to the supported actionable types here (or add handling for `url`/`report`/`action` and skip `separator`).
```
        {(resolvedNavigation).filter((n: any) => n.type !== 'group').slice(0, 5).map((item: any) => {
          const NavIcon = getIcon(item.icon);
          const baseUrl = `/apps/${activeAppName}`;
          let href = '#';
          if (item.type === 'object') href = `${baseUrl}/${item.objectName}`;
          else if (item.type === 'dashboard') href = item.dashboardName ? `${baseUrl}/dashboard/${item.dashboardName}` : '#';
          else if (item.type === 'page') href = item.pageName ? `${baseUrl}/page/${item.pageName}` : '#';
```
</details>

These transform tests lock in `pageName` values with leading slashes (e.g. `'/dashboard'` / `'/leads'`), which doesn't match how console routing and PageView resolve pages (they expect a page name like `help` / `crm_help`). Once the transform is fixed to strip/extract the page name, update these assertions to match the correct `pageName` output.
```suggestion
    expect(result.children![0].pageName).toBe('leads');
```

`menuItemToNavigationItem` inverts `hidden` via `!item.hidden`, but `hidden` can be a string expression (per MenuItem type). For a non-empty string this always becomes `false`, effectively hiding the item instead of converting to a negated visibility expression. Handle string expressions explicitly (e.g. turn "${...}" into "${!(...)}") and only boolean-negate when `hidden` is boolean.

Generated IDs use `migrated_${index}` with `index * 100 + i` for children, which can collide when a node has 100+ children (e.g. parent index 1 child i=100 collides with parent index 2 child i=0). Consider generating IDs based on the full path (e.g. a breadcrumb of indexes) or by hashing the path/label to guarantee uniqueness regardless of branching factor.
